name: Toast
description: Briefly reports what just happened, without blocking the page.

onDismiss.description: Callback when toast should be dismissed

tone.description: Colour on the shared status ramp; neutral is the plain notification. The useToast().error helper sets tone="danger".

duration.description: Auto-dismiss duration in ms (0 = no auto-dismiss)

onPause.description: Callback when auto-dismiss timer should pause

onResume.description: Callback when auto-dismiss timer should resume

when: News the user does not have to act on
Messages that can disappear on their own
whenNot: Errors the user must resolve — use Dialog
Anything that must stay on screen — use Alert
Field-level validation — use form error states
guidelines: One sentence, plus a title if it helps
Match the tone to what actually happened
Auto-dismiss in three to five seconds
Anything with an action needs a manual dismiss too
Two or three on screen at once, no more
useToast() helpers take (title, description) or an options object for action, duration, and id
accessibility: role="alert" for anything the user must not miss
Leave enough time to read it
Never let colour be the only signal
Give the dismiss button a real label

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Neutral message with a title and one line under it.
examples.code:
<Toast
  title="Draft saved"
  description="We will keep it until you publish."
/>

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: Icon and colour together carry the outcome.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="column" gap="sm">
  <Toast
    title="Success!"
    description="Your changes have been saved."
    tone="success"
  />
  <Toast
    title="Error"
    description="Failed to save changes. Please try again."
    tone="danger"
  />
  <Toast
    title="Warning"
    description="This action cannot be undone."
    tone="warning"
  />
  <Toast
    title="New update"
    description="Version 2.0 is now available."
    tone="info"
  />
</Stack>

examples.name: With Action
examples.description: One-tap way back from something destructive.
examples.code:
<Toast
  title="File deleted"
  description="The file has been moved to trash."
  action={{
    label: 'Undo',
    onClick: () => {},
  }}
/>

examples.name: Dismissible
examples.description: onDismiss adds a close button for longer messages.
examples.code:
<Toast
  title="Export running"
  description="We will email you when the file is ready."
  tone="info"
  onDismiss={() => {}}
/>

relations.note: Use Alert for persistent inline messages
Use Dialog for messages requiring user action

propsSummary: ToastInput (useToast): optional id for deterministic creation/replacement flows
useToast().success/error/warning/info: (title, description?) or ({ title, description, action, duration, id })
